description: Check an apex-grid `{ columns, data }` config against apexgrid-skill rules: columns/data required and array-shaped, every column.key must be a real key of the data rows, column.key unique, type is one of apex-grid's column types (string, number, boolean, date, currency, select and the other presentation types), sort/filter is boolean or config object, designSystem / tokens properties (if passed) are booleans. Returns structured issues with stable rule ids.

config.description: The apex-grid config `{ columns, data }` to validate.

name: apexgrid_validate_config
title: Validate apex-grid config
